sourceNote: Real sportsbook lines (spread, moneyline, total) via the SportsGameOdds API, pushed by the blitz-odds-odds-refresh scheduled task through the odds-update Netlify function (Netlify Blobs), NOT by a git commit -- this file on disk is a periodic mirror of that blob for local dev/reference, refreshed whenever the weekly-update task runs, but the live site fetches current odds at runtime from /.netlify/functions/odds-current rather than reading this file directly. Sportsbooks typically don't post lines until roughly 6-10 days before kickoff, so upcoming weeks show "Odds not yet posted" until they're live. Weeks -4 through -1 are the 2026 preseason (Hall of Fame Game, Preseason Weeks 1-3), matched against data/schedule-preseason-2026.json. Each game object may also carry an optional "books" map (draftkings/fanduel/betmgm/caesars/betrivers, each with spread, moneylineHome, moneylineAway, overUnder, favorite, asOf) with real per-sportsbook lines; the app shows that book's line when present for the user's selected sportsbook and falls back to this default line otherwise.
